title: Activist Sonam Wangchuck's Hunger Strike Enters Second Week
summary: Sonam Wangchuck, a social activist, has been on hunger strike at Jantar Mantar for over two weeks. The strike is in protest against the alleged irregularities in the upcoming parliamentary exams. Wangchuck has appealed to people not to see her as an 'ancient Gandhi' or a hero, but rather to find their own heroes. She also warned about the dangers of cheating in the exams.
summary_points: Sonam Wangchuck is on hunger strike at Jantar Mantar for over two weeks
The strike is in protest against alleged irregularities in parliamentary exams
Wangchuck has appealed to people not to see her as an 'ancient Gandhi' or a hero
She warned about the dangers of cheating in the exams
The strike is ongoing with Wangchuck's health reportedly deteriorating
